answer:
Yes, you can export your contacts (your customers) to a CSV file that opens in Excel:

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Make sure the list shows everyone you want. The export includes only the contacts currently shown, so clear any search or filter if you need all of them.
3. Select **Export CSV**.

The file includes each contact's name, email, phone, job title, company, status and custom fields. It also opens in Numbers and Google Sheets.
